start_here: Say to your AI: "Make speech of 'Fresh bread at seven.' with the voice program on this computer and keep the audio in a new folder." It writes the request file, runs generate_speech.py on your computer and tells you where the WAV file is.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads one request file you write, runs the voice program you name and keeps the audio files in a folder you give.
instructions: 1. Pick the program that makes your speech: a hosted service's caller (name the environment variables it reads for its key, never the key) or the voice program already on your computer, local_voice_provider.py (say or espeak-ng).
2. The AI writes request.json: {request_id, text, voice_profile_ref, provider: {argv: [..., "{request}", "{output}"], env_names, timeout_seconds}, options: {voice, language}, requested_at}.

3. It reads the tool row with tools:list {tool: "tool:generate-speech"} and runs its command on your computer: python3 trillion-workshop/tools/generate-speech/do-work/generate_speech.py --request request.json --out speech-folder.

4. Read the last line it prints, {"result": ...}: exit 0 with a speech-generation.result naming each audio file, or exit 2 with a speech-generation.error whose code (speech_provider_missing, speech_generation_empty_text, speech_provider_failed, ...) says what to change. Nothing is made up when it fails.

worked_examples.title: Speak one sentence with the local voice program
worked_examples.ask: Make speech of "Fresh bread at seven." with the voice program on this computer.
worked_examples.given: From tools/generate-speech/test/generate-speech.test.mjs (the first test, with a stand-in say program that writes half a second of silence as a WAV). The AI then runs: python3 trillion-workshop/tools/generate-speech/do-work/generate_speech.py --request request.json --out speech, where request.json is {"request_id":"req 1","text":"Fresh bread at seven.","voice_profile_ref":"voice:warm","requested_at":"2030-01-01T00:00:00Z","options":{"voice":"Maple","language":"en"},"provider":{"argv":["python3","trillion-workshop/tools/generate-speech/do-work/local_voice_provider.py","--request-json","{request}","--output-json","{output}"]}}.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result":{"kind":"speech-generation.result","request_id":"req 1","voice_profile_ref":"voice:warm","provider_ref":"local-voice:say","language":"en","format":"audio/wav","duration_ms":500,"output_artifact_refs":[{"media_type":"audio/wav","role":"speech-audio","path":"req_1-1.wav","byte_length":22094}],"src":"req_1-1.wav","completed_at":"2030-01-01T00:00:00Z"}} with exit 0, and speech/req_1-1.wav a real WAV (starts with RIFF). Without a provider the last line is a speech-generation.error with code speech_provider_missing and exit 2.
